diagnosis.defect: NewDetectCommonRegions returns before dequeuing when mbActiveLC=false. Run assigns uninitialized mpCurrentKF to mpLastCurrentKF, then dereferences it on the next iteration.

fix: Initialize mpCurrentKF to nullptr and do not enqueue place-recognition keyframes when mbActiveLC is false. Active-loop queue handling is retained.
